description: This is a Java test class for the ImportService in a book management application. It contains unit tests for importing Goodreads books, verifying behaviors such as saving valid books and handling invalid input cases.

classes.name: ImportServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for ImportService, verifying import behaviors with various GoodreadsBookImport inputs.

methods.name: ImportServiceTest
methods.description: Constructor injecting ImportService and BookService dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test by resetting services.

methods.name: resetServices
methods.description: Deletes all books from the BookService to reset state.

methods.name: saveWhenAuthorAndPredefinedShelfIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Tests saving a Goodreads book when author and shelf are provided.

methods.name: createGoodreadsImport
methods.description: Helper method to create a GoodreadsBookImport object with specified title, author, and shelf.

methods.name: returnEmptyListForEmptyImport
methods.description: Tests that importing an empty GoodreadsBookImport returns an empty list.

methods.name: generateBlankStrings
methods.description: Provides a stream of blank or null strings for parameterized tests.

methods.name: notSaveWhenTitleBlank
methods.description: Tests that a book with a blank title is not saved.

methods.name: notSaveWhenAuthorIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a book with a null author is not saved.

methods.name: notSaveWhenPredefinedShelfIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a book with a null shelf is not saved.
